en.s: The Battle of Pedroso was fought on 18 February 1071 at Pedroso, near the crossing of the Cávado River, next to the Monastery of São Martinho de Tibães near Braga, Portugal. The battle has sometimes been dated to January, following the date given in the Chronica Gothorum. However, a donation to the Monastery of Santo Antonino de Barbudo dated 17 February 1071 indicates that the battle took place later that month.

zh.s: 1071年2月18日，佩德罗索战役发生在葡萄牙布拉加附近，靠近卡瓦杜河渡口及蒂拜什圣马丁修道院。有些记载依据《哥特编年史》，将战役日期定在1月。但一份日期为1071年2月17日、向巴尔布杜圣安东尼诺修道院捐赠的文件表明，战斗发生在当月较晚时候。

en.t: FrederickII and al-Kamil conclude a ten-year truce
en.s: On 18 February 1229, Emperor FrederickII and Sultan al-Kamil concluded a treaty and ten-year truce during the Sixth Crusade. It transferred control of Jerusalem except certain Muslim holy sites; Muslims retained the Temple Mount area.

zh.t: 腓特烈二世与卡米勒达成十年休战
zh.s: 1229年2月18日，第六次十字军东征期间，皇帝腓特烈二世与苏丹卡米勒达成条约及十年休战。耶路撒冷的控制权转交基督徒一方，但部分穆斯林圣地除外，圣殿山一带仍由穆斯林控制。

loc: 意大利艾米利亚—罗马涅大区

en.s: The Battle of Parma was fought on 18 February 1248 between the forces of Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II and the Guelphs. The Guelphs attacked the Imperial camp when Frederick II was away. The Imperial forces were defeated and much of Frederick's treasure was lost.

zh.s: 1248年2月18日，神圣罗马皇帝腓特烈二世的军队与归尔甫派在帕尔马交战。腓特烈二世不在时，归尔甫派突袭帝国营地，击败帝国军，并使皇帝损失大量财宝。

en.t: Battle of Wesenberg fought near modern Rakvere
en.s: On 18 February 1268, forces from Novgorod and Pskov fought troops of Danish Estonia, the Bishopric of Dorpat, the Livonian Order and local Estonian militias near present-day Rakvere, Estonia. Medieval accounts differ, with both sides claiming victory.

zh.s: 1268年2月18日，诺夫哥罗德和普斯科夫的军队，在今爱沙尼亚拉克韦雷附近，与丹属爱沙尼亚、多尔帕特主教区、利沃尼亚骑士团及当地民兵交战。中世纪记载存在分歧，双方均声称获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Rudau (German: Schlacht bei Rudau, Lithuanian: Rūdavos mūšis) was a medieval pitched battle fought between the Teutonic Knights and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania on 17 or 18 February 1370 near Rudau village, north of Königsberg (now Melnikovo village in the Kaliningrad oblast). According to the Teutonic chronicler Wigand of Marburg and the Livonian chronicle of Hermann de Wartberge, the Lithuanians suffered a great defeat.

zh.s: 鲁道之战（德语：Schlacht bei Rudau；立陶宛语：Rūdavos mūšis）是中世纪的一场会战，条顿骑士团与立陶宛大公国于1370年2月17日或18日在鲁道村附近交战。鲁道位于柯尼斯堡以北（今俄罗斯加里宁格勒州梅利尼科沃村）。据条顿骑士团编年史作者马尔堡的维甘德及利沃尼亚编年史作者赫尔曼·德·瓦特贝格记载，立陶宛人遭到惨败。

en.s: The siege of Mazagan of 1562, also known as the Great Siege of Mazagan (Portuguese: Grande Cerco de Mazagão) was an armed engagement that took place in the modern city of El Jadida, then known as Mazagan, between Portuguese forces and those of the Saadi dynasty, which had unified Morocco a few years prior.

zh.s: 1562年的马扎甘围城战又称马扎甘大围城战（葡萄牙语：Grande Cerco de Mazagão），是葡萄牙军队与萨阿德王朝军队之间的一场武装冲突。萨阿德王朝几年前统一了摩洛哥。战斗发生在今摩洛哥杰迪代市，当时该城名为马扎甘。

en.s: (Not to be confused with Battle at The Lizard.) The Battle off Lizard Point was a naval action which took place on 18 February 1637 off the coast of Cornwall, England, during the Eighty Years' War. The Spanish admiral, Miguel de Horna, commander of the Armada of Flanders, intercepted an important Anglo-Dutch merchant convoy of 44 vessels escorted by six warships, destroying or capturing 20 of them, and returned safely to his base in Dunkirk.

zh.s: 1637年2月18日，八十年战争期间，西班牙佛兰德舰队司令米格尔·德·奥尔纳，在英格兰康沃尔利泽德角外海，拦截一支重要的英荷商船队。船队有44艘商船，由六艘战舰护航。奥尔纳击毁或俘获其中20艘，随后安全返回敦刻尔克基地。

en.s: The action of 18 February 1639 was a naval battle of the Eighty Years' War fought off Dunkirk between a Dutch fleet under the command of Admiral Maarten Tromp and the Spanish Dunkirk Squadron under Miguel de Horna. Horna, who had orders to join with his ships Admiral Antonio de Oquendo's fleet at A Coruña, escorted at the same time a transport convoy carrying 2,000 Walloon soldiers to Spain, where they were needed. The attempt to exit Dunkirk was done at the sight of the Dutch blockading squadron of Maarten Tromp.

zh.s: 1639年2月18日，八十年战争期间，马尔滕·特龙普海军上将率荷兰舰队，在敦刻尔克外海与米格尔·德·奥尔纳指挥的西班牙敦刻尔克分舰队交战。奥尔纳奉命率舰前往拉科鲁尼亚，与安东尼奥·德·奥肯多海军上将的舰队会合，同时护送一支运送2000名瓦隆士兵前往西班牙的运输船队。他试图驶出敦刻尔克时，特龙普的荷兰封锁舰队就在视线之内。

en.s: The Huilliche uprising of 1712 (Spanish: Rebelión huilliche de 1712) was an Indigenous uprising against the Spanish encomenderos of the Chiloé Archipelago, which was then a part of the Captaincy General of Chile. The rebellion took place in the central part of the archipelago.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1712年惠利切人起义（西班牙语：Rebelión huilliche de 1712）是当地原住民发动的一场起义，反抗智利都督辖区统治下奇洛埃群岛的西班牙委托监护制庄园主。起义发生在群岛中部。

en.s: On February 18, 1797, a fleet of 18 warships under the command of Sir Ralph Abercromby invaded and took the Island of Trinidad. Within a few days the last Spanish Governor, Don José María Chacón surrendered the island to Abercromby.

zh.s: 1797年2月18日，拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比爵士率领18艘军舰入侵并占领特立尼达岛。几天后，西班牙最后一任总督唐·何塞·玛丽亚·查孔向阿伯克龙比投降，交出该岛。

en.s: The Battle of the Malta Convoy was a naval engagement of the War of the Second Coalition fought on 18 February 1800 as part of the siege of Malta. The French garrison at the city of Valletta in Malta had been under siege for eighteen months, blockaded on the landward side by a combined force of British, Portuguese. and irregular Maltese forces and from the sea by a Royal Navy squadron under the overall command of Rear-Admiral of the Red Lord Nelson from his base at Palermo on Sicily.

zh.s: 马耳他船队海战发生于1800年2月18日，是第二次反法同盟战争期间、马耳他围城战的一场海战。法军在马耳他瓦莱塔驻守，已被围困18个月。陆上封锁由英国、葡萄牙和马耳他非正规部队联合实施，海上则由皇家海军中队封锁。该中队由红旗海军少将霍雷肖·纳尔逊总指挥，司令部设在西西里的巴勒莫。

en.s: The Battle of Montereau (18 February 1814) was fought during the War of the Sixth Coalition between an Imperial French army led by Emperor Napoleon and a corps of Austrians and Württembergers commanded by Crown Prince Frederick William of Württemberg. While Napoleon's army mauled an Allied army under Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, the main Allied army commanded by Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg advanced to a position dangerously close to Paris. Gathering up his outnumbered forces, Napoleon rushed his soldiers south to deal with Schwarzenberg. Hearing of the approach of the French emperor, the Allied commander ordered a withdrawal, but 17 February saw his rear guards overrun or brushed aside.

zh.s: 1814年2月18日，第六次反法同盟战争期间，拿破仑率法国帝国军队，与符腾堡王储腓特烈·威廉指挥的奥地利及符腾堡军团在蒙特罗交战。拿破仑正重创布吕歇尔所率联军时，施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普指挥的联军主力推进到危险地接近巴黎的位置。拿破仑集结人数处于劣势的部队，迅速南下应对。得知他逼近后，施瓦岑贝格下令撤退，但其后卫在2月17日已被法军冲垮或击退。

en.s: The Battle of Agüi was fought at Fuerte de Agüi, near Ancud, Chiloé on February 18, 1820 between Chilean patriots and Spanish royalists, during the Chilean War of Independence. After the successful capture of Valdivia Lord Cochrane sought to occupy the Chiloé Archipelago which was the last stronghold of the Spanish in Chile. William Miller disembarked for this task but had to reembark after had been severely wounded in his leg and lost 20 men.

zh.s: 阿圭之战于1820年2月18日在智利奇洛埃岛安库德附近的阿圭堡爆发，交战双方是智利独立派和西班牙保王派。成功攻占瓦尔迪维亚后，托马斯·科克伦勋爵试图占领奇洛埃群岛，因为那里是西班牙人在智利的最后据点。威廉·米勒率军执行任务，但腿部重伤并损失20名部下后，只得重新登船撤离。

en.s: The Raid of Kompolt was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848–1849, fought on 18 February 1849 between the 3-4 companies of Hussars of the Hungarian revolutionary Army led by Colonel Arisztid Dessewffy against a squadron of Cuirassiers of the Austrian Empire. The Hungarians ambushed the Austrian cavalry, defeating them, and putting them to flight.

zh.s: 孔波尔特突袭战是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争中的一场战斗，于1849年2月18日爆发。匈牙利革命军阿里斯蒂德·德热菲上校率领3至4个骠骑兵连，进攻奥地利帝国的一支胸甲骑兵中队。匈牙利人设伏击败奥军骑兵，并将其击退。

en.t: Jefferson Davis inaugurated as provisional Confederate president
en.s: On February 18, 1861, Jefferson Davis was inaugurated as provisional president of the Confederate States at the Alabama Capitol in Montgomery, in present-day United States. His later full-term inauguration was in 1862.

zh.t: 杰斐逊·戴维斯就任美利坚联盟国临时总统
zh.s: 1861年2月18日，杰斐逊·戴维斯在今美国阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利州议会大厦，宣誓就任美利坚联盟国临时总统。他正式任期的另一场就职仪式于1862年举行。

en.s: On 18 February 1873, Bulgarian revolutionary Vasil Levski was hanged by Ottoman authorities in Sofia, in present-day Bulgaria.
en.n: Gregorian February18 corresponds to February6 in the Julian calendar.

zh.t: 瓦西尔·列夫斯基在索非亚被处死
zh.s: 1873年2月18日，保加利亚革命者瓦西尔·列夫斯基被奥斯曼当局在索非亚处以绞刑，地点位于今保加利亚。
zh.n: 公历2月18日对应儒略历2月6日。

en.t: John Tunstall killed, triggering the Lincoln County War
en.s: On February 18, 1878, John Tunstall was killed by members of a sheriff’s posse in New Mexico Territory, in present-day United States. His killing triggered the Lincoln County War.

zh.t: 约翰·坦斯托尔遇害，引发林肯县战争
zh.s: 1878年2月18日，约翰·坦斯托尔在今美国新墨西哥地区遭治安官民团成员杀害。他的遇害引发林肯县战争。

en.s: On 18 February 1897, British forces captured Benin City, in present-day Nigeria, during their invasion of the Kingdom of Benin. The expedition resulted in widespread destruction and the removal of artworks from the city.

zh.s: 1897年2月18日，英军在入侵贝宁王国期间攻占贝宁城，地点位于今尼日利亚。这次远征造成大规模破坏，大批艺术品被运走。

en.s: The Battle of Paardeberg or Perdeberg ("Horse Mountain", 18–27 February 1900) was a major battle during the Second Anglo-Boer War. It was fought near Paardeberg Drift on the banks of the Modder River in the Orange Free State near Kimberley (now in Letsemeng Local Municipality, Free State). Lord Methuen advanced up the railway line in November 1899 with the objective of relieving the Siege of Kimberley (and the town of Mafeking, also under siege).

zh.s: 帕德伯格战役又称佩尔德贝格战役（意为“马山”），于1900年2月18日至27日爆发，是第二次英布战争中的一场重要战役。战斗发生在奥兰治自由邦帕德伯格渡口附近的莫德河岸边，靠近金伯利（今属自由邦莱塞门市）。1899年11月，梅休因勋爵沿铁路推进，目标是解救遭围困的金伯利和马弗京镇。

en.s: Bloody Sunday of February 18, 1900, was a day of high Imperial casualties in the Second Boer War.

zh.s: 1900年2月18日的“血腥星期日”是第二次布尔战争期间英帝国军队伤亡惨重的一天。

en.t: Édouard de Laveleye forms the Belgian Olympic Committee
en.s: On 18 February 1906, Édouard de Laveleye formed the Belgian Olympic Committee at Hotel Ravenstein in Brussels, Belgium, and was elected its first president.

zh.t: 爱德华·德·拉弗莱在布鲁塞尔成立比利时奥委会
zh.s: 1906年2月18日，爱德华·德·拉弗莱在比利时布鲁塞尔拉文斯坦酒店成立比利时奥林匹克委员会，并当选首任主席。

en.s: The Zaraniq rebellion was a rebellion of the Zaraniq Tribe that took place between 1909 and 1910 in the Yemen Vilayet, which was then part of the Ottoman Empire. The rebellion was fought for two reasons: Opposition to the extension of telegraph lines through their territory, and the unmet demand that the sons of their leaders held hostage in Hodeida, Bayt al-Faqih and other localities be released from prison.

zh.s: 扎拉尼克人起义是1909年至1910年间发生在奥斯曼帝国也门行省的一场部族起义。起义有两个原因：部族反对电报线穿过其领地，以及部族首领的儿子被扣为人质、关押在荷台达、贝特·法基赫等地，首领要求释放他们却未能如愿。

en.s: The 1914 Wycombe by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 18 February 1914. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 英国威科姆选区于1914年2月18日举行议会补选，采用得票最多者当选的制度，选出一名下议院议员。

en.s: The Hong Kong Sanitary Board Election of 1916 was held on 18 February 1916 for an elected seat in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. The election was held for the two of the elected seats in the board due to the resignation of Dr. G. H. L. Fitzwilliams who resigned in January. There were eight spoilt papers and only 323 of the Jury List of between 1,100 and 1,200 votes. Dr. F. M. G. Ozorio returned to the office by large majority over Dr. H. G. Earle, a professor at the University of Hong Kong.

zh.s: 香港洁净局于1916年2月18日举行议席选举，起因为G.H.L.菲茨威廉斯医生在1月辞职。原文对改选席数有一席及两席两种表述。陪审员名册上约有1100至1200名合资格选民，但仅323人投票，另有八张废票。F.M.G.奥索里奥医生以明显多数击败香港大学教授H.G.厄尔医生，重返洁净局。

en.t: Operations against the Marri and Khetran tribes
en.s: Operations against the Marri and Khetran tribes (also known as the Marri Punitive Expedition) was the British name for a punitive expedition carried out against the Marri and Khetran tribes of Balochistan, British India between February and April 1918. The Marri rose against the British authorities around 18 February, encouraged by rumours that the British were short of manpower due to the First World War.

zh.t: 对马里和赫特兰部族的军事行动
zh.s: 对马里和赫特兰部族的军事行动又称马里惩罚远征，是英国对英属印度俾路支地区马里和赫特兰部族实施惩罚性远征的名称，行动于1918年2月至4月间进行。第一次世界大战期间，英国人力短缺的传言促使马里人起事，时间约为2月18日。

en.s: The Cardiganshire by-election, 1921 was a parliamentary by-election held for the British House of Commons constituency of Cardiganshire on 18 February 1921. The election was important for the bitterness of the contest between the Coalition and Independent factions within the Liberal Party and the deepening of this division within the party as a factor in the long term decline of Liberalism in Wales.

zh.s: 英国下议院卡迪根郡选区于1921年2月18日举行补选。自由党内部联合政府派与独立派的竞争极其激烈，加深了党内分裂，也成为威尔士自由主义势力长期衰落的一个因素。

en.s: The Manchester Clayton by-election of 18 February 1922 was held after the death of the Conservative politician and Member of Parliament (MP) Edward Hopkinson. Labour took the seat in the by-election.

zh.t: 1922年曼彻斯特克莱顿选区补选
zh.s: 保守党政治家、议员爱德华·霍普金森去世后，曼彻斯特克莱顿选区于1922年2月18日举行补选，工党夺得议席。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Yarra on 18 February 1922. This was triggered by the death of Labor MP Frank Tudor, the Leader of the Opposition. The by-election was won by Labor candidate and future Prime Minister James Scullin.

zh.s: 1922年2月18日，澳大利亚众议院亚拉选区举行补选。此次补选由工党议员、反对党领袖弗兰克·都铎去世引发。工党候选人、未来的澳大利亚总理詹姆斯·斯卡林赢得选举。

en.t: Clyde Tombaugh identifies Pluto in photographic plates
en.s: On February 18, 1930, Clyde Tombaugh identified a moving object in photographic plates at Lowell Observatory in Flagstaff, Arizona, United States. The object was later named Pluto. Its discovery was publicly announced in March.

zh.t: 克莱德·汤博从照片中发现冥王星
zh.s: 1930年2月18日，克莱德·汤博在美国亚利桑那州弗拉格斯塔夫的洛厄尔天文台，比对照片时辨认出一个移动天体，后来被命名为冥王星。这一发现于3月才公开宣布。

en.s: The Manchester Gorton by-election of 1937 was held on 18 February 1937. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Labour MP, Joseph Compton. It was won by the Labour candidate William Wedgwood Benn.

zh.s: 英国曼彻斯特戈顿选区于1937年2月18日举行补选，原因是工党现任议员约瑟夫·康普顿去世。工党候选人威廉·韦奇伍德·本获胜。

en.s: The bombing of Chongqing (simplified Chinese: 重庆大轰炸; traditional Chinese: 重慶大轟炸, Japanese: 重慶爆撃), from 18 February 1938 to 19 December 1944, was a series of massive terror bombing operations authorized by the Empire of Japan's Imperial General Headquarters and conducted by the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service (IJAAF) and Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service (IJNAF).

en.t: Nanking Safety Zone committee reorganized as a relief committee
en.s: On February 18, 1938, the International Committee for the Nanking Safety Zone in Nanjing, China, was reorganized as the Nanking International Relief Committee. It continued humanitarian relief work; this administrative change does not establish an end to atrocities that day.

zh.t: 南京安全区国际委员会改组为国际救济委员会
zh.s: 1938年2月18日，中国南京的安全区国际委员会改组为南京国际救济委员会，继续开展人道救济。这一机构调整并不表示当地暴行在当天结束。

en.s: Operation Jericho was a low-level Second World War bombing raid on 18 February 1944, by Allied aircraft on Amiens Prison in German-occupied France. The objective of the raid was to free French Resistance and political prisoners. The raid is remarkable for the precision and daring of the attack, which was filmed by a camera on one of the aeroplanes. There is debate as to who requested the attack and whether it was necessary. Mosquito bombers succeeded in breaching the walls and buildings of the prison, as well as destroying guards' barracks.

zh.s: 1944年2月18日，二战期间，盟军飞机低空轰炸德占法国的亚眠监狱，旨在释放法国抵抗运动成员和政治犯，代号“耶利哥”行动。这次攻击因精确而大胆著称，一架飞机上的摄影机拍下了过程。究竟是谁要求发动空袭、行动是否必要，至今仍有争议。蚊式轰炸机成功炸开监狱围墙及建筑，并摧毁警卫营房。

en.t: Karavia Bay engagement ends after overnight action
en.s: During the night of17–18February1944, US warships attacked harbor defenses and Japanese shipping at Karavia Bay near Rabaul, in present-day Papua New Guinea. The engagement ended with Japanese artillery silenced.
en.n: February18 is the endpoint of the overnight engagement; the retained action report states times are local.

zh.s: 1944年2月17日至18日夜间，美军舰艇在拉包尔附近的卡拉维亚湾攻击港口防御设施及日军船只，地点位于今巴布亚新几内亚。战斗结束时，日军岸炮被压制。
zh.n: 2月18日为夜间交战的结束日期，原文所引战斗报告采用当地时间。

en.s: Operation Encore was the Allied offensive timed for February—March 1945, to break through the Gothic Line. This was initiated at the army instead of corps level.
en.n: World War II: American and Brazilian troops kick off Operation Encore in Northern Italy, a successful limited action in the Northern Apennines that prepares for the western portion of the Allied Spring offensive.

zh.s: “回响”行动是盟军于1945年2月至3月间为突破哥特防线而安排的攻势。此次行动由军级而非军团级指挥。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：美军和巴西军队在意大利北部发起“回响”行动。这是一场取得成功的有限军事行动，为盟军春季攻势的西段作战作准备。

en.s: Operation Solstice (German: Unternehmen Sonnenwende), also known as Unternehmen Husarenritt or the Stargard tank battle, was one of the last German armoured offensive operations on the Eastern Front in World War II. It was originally planned as a major offensive but was executed as a limited attack, due to hasty planning by the Germans and it being partially compromised by Soviet military intelligence.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 冬至行动（德语：Unternehmen Sonnenwende）又称“骑兵突袭行动”或斯塔加德坦克战，是第二次世界大战东线德军最后几次装甲攻势之一。该行动原计划发动大规模攻势，但由于德军计划仓促，且部分内容已被苏联军事情报掌握，最终只实施了有限攻击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Western Carpathian offensive (Russian: Западно-Карпатская наступательная операция) was a successful offensive by the Red Army during World War II, that lasted from January 12 to February 18, 1945.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西喀尔巴阡攻势是第二次世界大战期间红军取得成功的一次攻势，持续于1945年1月12日至2月18日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Royal Indian Navy revolt (also called the Royal Indian Navy mutiny or Bombay mutiny) encompasses a total strike and subsequent revolt by Indian sailors of the Royal Indian Navy on board ship and shore establishments at Bombay (Mumbai) harbour on 18 February 1946. From the initial flashpoint in Bombay, the revolt spread and found support throughout British India, from Karachi to Calcutta and ultimately came to involve over 10,000 sailors in 66 ships and shore establishments. The mutiny was repressed with force by British troops and Royal Navy warships. Total casualties were 8 dead and 33 wounded.

zh.s: 1946年2月18日，印度皇家海军的印度水兵，在孟买港舰艇及岸上设施全面罢工，继而起义，又称孟买兵变。起义从孟买蔓延并获得英属印度各地支持，范围从卡拉奇到加尔各答，最终涉及66艘舰艇及岸上设施的超过一万名水兵。英国军队及皇家海军军舰武力镇压起义，总计八人死亡、33人受伤。

en.t: Viet Minh withdraws its Capital Regiment from Hanoi
en.s: On February 18, 1947, Viet Minh commander Vương Thừa Vũ withdrew the Capital Regiment across the Red River from Hanoi, Vietnam, after two months of fighting with French forces.

zh.s: 1947年2月18日，与法军交战两个月后，越盟指挥官王承武率首都团渡过红河，撤出越南河内。

en.s: The Third Battle of Wonju, was a series of engagements between North Korean and United Nations (UN) forces during the Korean War. The battle took place from 13 to 18 February 1951 north of the South Korean town of Wonju. While the Korean People's Army (KPA) achieved some initial successes, their attacks petered out in the face of strong UN defences and as their supply lines became overstretched and by 18 February they had begun to withdraw across the entire front.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 原州第三次战役是朝鲜战争期间朝鲜人民军与联合国军之间的一系列交战，发生于1951年2月13日至18日，战场位于韩国原州以北。朝鲜人民军最初取得一些战果，但在联合国军的坚固防线面前攻势逐渐受挫，补给线也拉得过长。到2月18日，朝鲜人民军已开始沿整条战线撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 1954 Patiala and East Punjab States Union Legislative Assembly election
en.s: Elections to the Legislative Assembly of the Indian state of Patiala and East Punjab States Union were held on 18 February 1954. 279 candidates competed for the 48 constituencies in the Assembly. There were twelve two-member constituencies and 36 single-member constituencies. Out of these, 2 single member constituencies were reserved for SC.

zh.t: 1954年帕蒂亚拉与东旁遮普邦联议会选举
zh.s: 印度帕蒂亚拉与东旁遮普邦联于1954年2月18日举行议会选举。279名候选人争夺48个选区，其中12个为双议席选区，36个为单议席选区，其中两个单议席选区为表列种姓保留。

en.s: Operation Teapot was a series of 14 nuclear test explosions conducted at the Nevada Test Site in the first half of 1955. It was preceded by Operation Castle, and followed by Operation Wigwam. Wigwam was, administratively, a part of Teapot, but it is usually treated as a class of its own. The aims of the operation were to establish military tactics for ground forces on a nuclear battlefield and to improve the nuclear weapons used for strategic delivery.
en.n: Operation Teapot: Teapot test shot "Wasp" is successfully detonated at the Nevada Test Site with a yield of 1.2 kilotons. Wasp is the first of fourteen shots in the Teapot series.

zh.s: 茶壶行动是1955年上半年在内华达试验场进行的一系列核试验，共有14次核爆。此前进行的是城堡行动，之后是威格瓦姆行动。威格瓦姆在行政管理上属于茶壶行动，但通常单独归类。试验旨在制定核战场上的地面部队战术，并改进用于战略投送的核武器。
zh.n: 茶壶行动：内华达试验场成功引爆代号“黄蜂”的茶壶核试验，爆炸当量为1.2千吨。“黄蜂”是茶壶行动14次核试验中的首次。

en.t: Walter Bolton becomes New Zealand’s last executed prisoner
en.s: On 18 February 1957, Walter James Bolton was hanged at Mount Eden Prison in Auckland, New Zealand, after being convicted of murdering his wife. He was the last person executed in the country; statutory abolition came later.

zh.t: 沃尔特·博尔顿成为新西兰最后一名被处决者
zh.s: 1957年2月18日，沃尔特·詹姆斯·博尔顿因谋杀妻子被定罪后，在新西兰奥克兰伊甸山监狱被处以绞刑。他成为新西兰最后一名被处决者，法律上废除死刑则是在后来。

en.t: Dedan Kimathi executed in colonial Kenya
en.s: On 18 February 1957, Mau Mau leader Dedan Kimathi was hanged at Kamiti Prison near Nairobi by British colonial authorities in Kenya.

zh.t: 德丹·基马蒂在肯尼亚被殖民当局处死
zh.s: 1957年2月18日，茅茅运动领导人德丹·基马蒂，被英国殖民当局在肯尼亚内罗毕附近的卡米蒂监狱处以绞刑。

en.t: Jammu and Kashmir Assembly election reaches its final polling day
en.s: On 18 February 1962, the Legislative Assembly election in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir reached the end of its February17–18 polling period.
en.n: This concerns the Indian-administered electoral jurisdiction, not all Kashmir. The region’s status is disputed.

zh.t: 查谟和克什米尔议会选举完成投票
zh.s: 1962年2月18日，印度管辖的查谟和克什米尔地区议会选举，完成2月17日至18日的投票。
zh.n: 此条为印度管辖地区的议会选举，不涵盖整个克什米尔；该地区地位存在争议。

en.t: The Gambia gains independence from Britain
en.s: On 18 February 1965, The Gambia became independent from the United Kingdom. It initially retained the British monarch as head of state and became a republic in 1970.

zh.s: 1965年2月18日，冈比亚脱离英国独立。独立初期仍以英国君主为国家元首，于1970年才成为共和国。

en.s: Operation Bribie (17–18 February 1967), also known as the Battle of Ap My An, was fought during the Vietnam War in Phuoc Tuy province between Australian forces from the 6th Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment (6 RAR) and two companies of Viet Cong from D445 Battalion, likely reinforced by North Vietnamese regulars.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 布里比行动又称安平美战役，发生于1967年2月17日至18日，是越南战争期间的一场战斗。交战双方是澳大利亚皇家团第6营（6 RAR）和越共D445营的两个连，后者可能还得到北越正规军增援。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Himachal Pradesh’s Santokhgarh constituency holds its assembly poll
en.s: On February 18, 1967, Santokhgarh constituency voted in Himachal Pradesh’s legislative assembly election in India. Three candidates contested the seat; the votes were counted four days later.
en.n: This is the polling date for Santokhgarh constituency, rather than a single polling day for all of Himachal Pradesh.

zh.t: 喜马偕尔邦桑托克加尔选区举行议会投票
zh.s: 1967年2月18日，印度喜马偕尔邦桑托克加尔选区举行议会投票，三名候选人争夺这个议席，四天后计票。
zh.n: 这是桑托克加尔选区的投票日期，并非喜马偕尔邦全境统一的投票日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were due to be held in Cyprus on 18 February 1973. However, as incumbent President Makarios III was the only candidate, the elections were not held and Makarios III was automatically declared the winner.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯原定于1973年2月18日举行总统选举，但现任总统马卡里奥斯三世是唯一候选人，因此没有实际举行投票，他被自动宣布当选。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 18 February 1976. Whilst the Progressive Labour Movement received the most votes, the opposition Antigua Labour Party won more than double the number of seats. ALP leader Vere Bird was elected Premier of Antigua. Bird had previously served as head of government of Antigua and Barbuda between 1960 and 1971.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1976年2月18日举行大选。进步劳工运动虽然获得最多选票，反对党安提瓜工党赢得的席位却超过其两倍。工党领袖维尔·伯德当选安提瓜首席部长，他此前曾于1960年至1971年担任政府首脑。

en.s: The 61st Regiment Farm fire occurred on 18 February 1977, at a frontier farm outside of Khorgos, Xinjiang, China. The fire broke out during a movie screening at the communal hall for Chinese New Year, when a 12-year-old audience member set off a ground-spinning firecracker, which ignited mourning wreaths for Mao Zedong displaying in the hall. Although the wreaths should have been incinerated months before, the regiment felt pressure to keep them.

zh.s: 1977年2月18日，中国新疆霍尔果斯郊外一处边境团场发生火灾。春节期间，公共礼堂放映电影时，一名12岁观众燃放地上旋转的鞭炮，点燃礼堂中陈列的悼念毛泽东的花圈。花圈原应在数月前焚化，但团场因感到压力而继续保留。

en.s: The Rangitikei by-election of 1978 was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Rangitikei, a predominantly rural district in the middle of New Zealand's North Island. The by-election occurred on 18 February 1978, and was precipitated by the death of sitting National Party MP (and Speaker of the House) Sir Roy Jack in December 1977.

zh.s: 新西兰北岛中部、以乡村为主的朗伊蒂凯选区，于1978年2月18日举行补选。国家党现任议员兼众议院议长罗伊·杰克爵士于1977年12月去世，议席因此出缺。

en.s: The Second National Parliamentary Elections 1979 (Bengali: দ্বিতীয় জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচন ১৯৭৯) were held in Bangladesh on 18 February 1979. The result was a victory for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, which won 207 of the 300 seats. Voter turnout was 51.3%.

zh.s: 孟加拉国于1979年2月18日举行第二届国民议会选举。孟加拉国民族主义党获胜，赢得300席中的207席。投票率为51.3%。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1980 was held on February 18, 1980 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 32nd Parliament of Canada. It was called when the minority Progressive Conservative government led by Prime Minister Joe Clark was defeated in the Commons. Clark and his government had been under attack for its perceived inexperience, for example, in its handling of its 1979 election campaign commitment to move Canada's embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. Clark had maintained uneasy relations with the fourth largest party in the House of Commons, Social Credit.

zh.s: 加拿大于1980年2月18日举行联邦大选，选出第32届国会众议员。总理乔·克拉克领导的进步保守党少数政府在众议院投票中失利，因而提前选举。克拉克政府因被认为缺乏经验而受抨击，例如处理1979年竞选时承诺将加拿大驻以色列大使馆从特拉维夫迁往耶路撒冷一事。他与众议院第四大党社会信用党的关系也一直紧张。

en.s: The February 1982 Irish general election to the 23rd Dáil was held on Thursday, 18 February, three weeks after the dissolution of the 22nd Dáil on 27 January by President Patrick Hillery on the request of Taoiseach Garret FitzGerald on the defeat of the government's budget. The general election took place in 41 Dáil constituencies throughout Ireland for 166 seats in Dáil Éireann, the house of representatives of the Oireachtas.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1982年2月18日（星期四）举行大选，选出第23届众议院。此前三周，帕特里克·希勒里总统应总理加勒特·菲茨杰拉德请求，于1月27日解散第22届众议院；政府预算案遭否决是解散议会的原因。全国41个选区共选出爱尔兰议会下院166名议员。

en.s: The Wah Mee massacre was a mass shooting that occurred during the night of February 18–19, 1983, in the Wah Mee gambling club at the Louisa Hotel in Seattle, Washington, United States. Fourteen people were bound, robbed and shot by three gunmen, 22-year-old Kwan Fai "Willie" Mak, 20-year old Keung Kin "Benjamin" Ng and 25-year-old Wai Chiu "Tony" Ng (no relation).

zh.s: 1983年2月18日至19日夜间，美国华盛顿州西雅图路易莎酒店的华美赌博俱乐部发生大规模枪击。22岁的麦冠辉、20岁的伍强健及25岁的伍伟超三名枪手，将14人捆绑、抢劫后开枪射击。两名伍姓枪手没有亲属关系。

en.s: The Nellie massacre took place in central Assam during a seven-hour period on the morning of 18 February 1983. The massacre claimed the lives of 2000–3000 people from 14 villages—Alisingha, Khulapathar, Basundhari, Bugduba Beel, Bugduba Habi, Borjola, Butuni, Dongabori, Indurmari, Mati Parbat, Muladhari, Mati Parbat no. 8, Silbheta, Borburi and Nellie—of Nagaon district. The victims were people of Bengali Muslim descent.

zh.s: 1983年2月18日上午，印度阿萨姆邦中部发生内莉大屠杀，屠杀持续了7小时。纳冈县14个村庄共有2,000至3,000人遇害，村庄包括阿利辛加、库拉帕塔尔、巴孙达里、布格杜巴比尔、布格杜巴哈比、博尔乔拉、布图尼、东加博里、因杜尔马里、马蒂帕尔巴特、穆拉达里、马蒂帕尔巴特8号、锡尔贝塔、博尔布里和内莉。遇难者是孟加拉裔穆斯林。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Hughes on 18 February 1984. This was triggered by the resignation of Labor Party MP Les Johnson to become Australian High Commissioner to New Zealand. The by-election was held to coincide with the Corangamite and Richmond by-elections. The election was won by Labor candidate Robert Tickner, despite a 5.3% swing to the Liberal Party.

zh.s: 1984年2月18日，澳大利亚众议院休斯选区举行补选。工党议员莱斯·约翰逊辞职出任澳大利亚驻新西兰高级专员，因此触发补选。补选与科朗加米特和里士满选区补选同时举行。尽管自由党支持率上升5.3个百分点，工党候选人罗伯特·蒂克纳仍赢得选举。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Corangamite on 18 February 1984. This was triggered by the resignation of Liberal Party MP Tony Street. The by-election was held to coincide with the Hughes and Richmond by-elections. The election was comfortably won by Liberal candidate Stewart McArthur.

zh.s: 1984年2月18日，澳大利亚众议院科朗加米特选区举行补选。自由党议员托尼·斯特里特辞职，引发此次补选。补选与休斯和里士满选区同时举行。自由党候选人斯图尔特·麦克阿瑟以明显优势获胜。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Richmond on 18 February 1984. This was triggered by the resignation of National Party Leader MP Doug Anthony. The by-election was held to coincide with the Corangamite and Hughes by-elections. The election was won by National candidate and future Nationals leader, Charles Blunt, despite challenges from both the Labor and Liberal parties.

zh.s: 1984年2月18日，澳大利亚众议院里士满选区举行补选。国家党领袖兼议员道格·安东尼辞职，引发此次补选。补选与科朗加米特和休斯选区同时举行。国家党候选人、未来的国家党领袖查尔斯·布伦特赢得选举，尽管工党和自由党候选人都参与角逐。

en.t: The War to Settle the Score
en.s: The War to Settle the Score was a professional wrestling event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place at Madison Square Garden in New York, New York on February 18, 1985. The main event featured Hulk Hogan defending the WWF World Heavyweight Championship against "Rowdy" Roddy Piper. Hogan retained the title after Piper got disqualified in the only match of the event that was shown on MTV.

zh.s: 一决恩怨是世界摔角联盟（WWF）于1985年2月18日在美国纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举办的职业摔角赛事。主赛中，胡克·霍根面对“暴躁”罗迪·派珀挑战，保卫WWF世界重量级冠军。派珀被取消资格，霍根因此保住头衔。这也是整场赛事唯一在MTV播出的比赛。

zh.s: 日本于1990年2月18日举行全国众议院选举。众议院是日本国会下院，权力大于上院。

en.t: Bombings of Paddington and Victoria stations
en.s: On 18 February 1991 two Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) bombs exploded at London mainline stations, one at Victoria station and the other at Paddington station, killing one person and injuring 38 other people at Victoria station. It was the IRA's second major attack in London in February 1991 after the Downing Street mortar attack eleven days earlier which was an attempt to assassinate the British War cabinet and the British prime minister John Major.

zh.t: 帕丁顿及维多利亚车站爆炸案
zh.s: 1991年2月18日，临时爱尔兰共和军的两枚炸弹分别在伦敦维多利亚及帕丁顿两座铁路干线车站爆炸，维多利亚站有一人死亡、38人受伤。这是共和军当年2月在伦敦的第二次重大袭击。11天前，它曾用迫击炮袭击唐宁街，企图刺杀英国首相约翰·梅杰及战时内阁。

en.s: The 1992 New Hampshire Democratic presidential primary was held on February 18, in New Hampshire as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1992 United States presidential election. The primary was won by former Massachusetts Senator Paul Tsongas, but became historically significant for the surprising second-place finish of Arkansas Governor Bill Clinton, who would go on to win both the Democratic nomination and the presidency.

zh.t: 1992年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1992年2月18日，民主党在新罕布什尔州举行总统候选人初选，是该党为1992年美国总统选举提名候选人而在各州举行的初选之一。前马萨诸塞州参议员保罗·松加斯获胜，但阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿意外名列第二，使这次初选受到历史关注。克林顿后来赢得民主党提名并当选总统。

en.s: The 1995 Australian Capital Territory election was held on 18 February 1995 to elect all 17 members of the Australian Capital Territory Legislative Assembly. A referendum on entrenching the ACT's electoral system was also held alongside the election. Like the 1989 and 1992 elections, the result was another hung parliament. However, the Liberal Party were able to form government with the support of Michael Moore and Paul Osborne.

zh.s: 澳大利亚首都领地于1995年2月18日举行选举，改选立法议会全部17名议员。选举同时举行公投，讨论是否将首都领地选举制度写入法律、使其不易被更改。与1989年和1992年选举一样，此次选举再次出现无人取得多数席位的议会。不过，自由党在迈克尔·摩尔和保罗·奥斯本的支持下组建了政府。

en.s: During the night of February17–18,2001, violence broke out between Dayak and Madurese residents in Sampit, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, following a house fire. It spread to other areas and caused mass deaths and displacement.

en.s: The Daegu subway fire was a mass murder on February 18, 2003, that killed 192 people and injured 151 people. An arsonist set fire to a train stopped at the Jungangno Station of the Daegu Metropolitan Subway in Daegu, South Korea. The fire then spread to a second train that had entered the station from the opposite direction a few minutes later.

en.s: The Nishapur train disaster was a large explosion in the village of Khayyam, near Nishapur in Iran, on 18 February 2004. Over 300 people were killed and the entire village destroyed when runaway train wagons crashed into the community in the middle of the night and exploded.

en.s: The 2007 A-League Grand Final took place at Etihad Stadium in Melbourne, Australia, on 18 February 2007. The match was contested by premiers Melbourne Victory and Adelaide United, who had to play over half the game with ten men after their captain Ross Aloisi was sent off after 34 minutes. After the game, Adelaide coach John Kosmina heavily criticized the refereeing of the match and this, coupled with other issues, saw him forced to resign by the Adelaide board. Melbourne prevailed 6-0 in the joint largest win in A-League history, and the greatest ever deficit in any Australian soccer Grand Final, including the old NSL.

zh.s: 2007年澳超总决赛于2月18日在澳大利亚墨尔本阿提哈德体育场举行，由常规赛冠军墨尔本胜利对阵阿德莱德联。阿德莱德队长罗斯·阿洛伊西在第34分钟被罚下，球队超过半场时间只能以十人应战。墨尔本最终以6比0获胜，追平澳超最大分差纪录，也创下包括旧全国足球联赛在内，澳大利亚足球总决赛最大分差。赛后阿德莱德教练约翰·科斯米纳严厉批评裁判，加上其他问题，被俱乐部董事会要求辞职。

en.s: General elections were held in Pakistan on 18 February 2008, after being postponed from 8 January 2008. The original date was intended to elect members of the National Assembly, the lower house of the Parliament of Pakistan. On 3 November 2007, President and Chief of army staff General Pervez Musharraf enacted a state of emergency; elections were initially postponed indefinitely. However, it was later stated they would be held as planned. On 8 November 2007, Musharraf announced that the election would be held by 15 February 2008, but the election date was changed to occur on or before 9 January 2008.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2008年2月18日举行大选，较原定1月8日推迟，选出国民议会、即议会下院议员。2007年11月3日，总统兼陆军参谋长佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫将军宣布紧急状态，选举一度被无限期推迟，后来又表示仍按计划举行。11月8日，穆沙拉夫宣布将在2008年2月15日前举行选举，此后日期又改为2008年1月9日或以前，最终再延期至2月18日。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Armenia on 18 February 2013. In the run-up to the elections, Armenian's first President Levon Ter-Petrosyan and one of the richest men in the country Gagik Tsarukyan, leader of the second largest parliamentary party Prosperous Armenia, withdrew from the race in December 2012. Many believed that no candidate would be able to challenge incumbent President Serzh Sargsyan, others stated that people see "absence of alternatives" and these factors caused great apathy among the public. On 31 January 2013, candidate Paruyr Hayrikyan was shot, but he recovered soon and urged two other main opposition candidates Raffi Hovannisian and Hrant Bagratyan to unite around a single opposition candidate, in order to defeat President Sargsyan.

zh.s: 亚美尼亚于2013年2月18日举行总统选举。选前，该国首任总统列翁·特尔-彼得罗相，以及国内最富有人士之一、议会第二大党繁荣亚美尼亚党领袖加吉克·察鲁基扬，于2012年12月退出竞争。许多人认为无人能够挑战现任总统谢尔日·萨尔基相，也有人说民众看不到其他选择，这些因素造成公众普遍冷漠。2013年1月31日，候选人帕鲁伊尔·海里基扬遭枪击，但很快康复，并呼吁两名主要反对派候选人拉菲·霍万尼相及赫兰特·巴格拉强，围绕单一候选人联合起来，击败萨尔基相。

en.s: General elections were held in Uganda on 18 February 2016 to elect the President and Parliament. Polling day was declared a national holiday. Presidential candidates included incumbent Yoweri Museveni, in power since 1986, Kizza Besigye, who had run against Museveni in 2001, 2006 and 2011, former Prime Minister Amama Mbabazi, Abed Bwanika who has also challenged Museveni in 2001, 2006 and 2011, former Makerere University Vice Chancellor Venansius Baryamureeba, retired Army General Benon Biraaro, Joseph Mabirizi and former presidential advisor Faith Kyalya. Claims of rigging and violence at polling stations were reported and voting was extended in several locations after reports of people not being allowed to cast their votes.

en.s: The 2017 CAF Super Cup (officially the 2017 Total CAF Super Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the 25th CAF Super Cup, an annual football match in Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's two CAF club competitions, the CAF Champions League and the CAF Confederation Cup.
